versions.localizedDescription:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stossy11/MeloCafe/commits/1.0

# Changelog

- Initial Release
- Full iOS Support
- Metal Argument Buffers
- Cached Threaded Interpreter.

This is the first release of MeloCafe, there **WILL** be bugs, glitches, performance issues and unintended behavior which will get fixed in the future
